answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 152801 Country: India Title: If a Muslim died in Ramadan directly go to jannah without any questions. Is it correct? Because the jahannam is closed in Ramadan. Please clear it. Question: If a Muslim died in Ramadan directly go to jannah without any questions. Is it correct? Because the jahannam is closed in Ramadan. Please clear it. Answer ID: 152801 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1019/870/D=10/1438) We could not find any Hadith with these words. However there is one Hadith about dying on Friday or Friday night. ان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال من مات ليلة الجمعة او يوم الجمعة برى من فتنة القبر او قال وقى فتنة القبر وكتب شهيدا مصنف عبدالرزاق ر ق م : 5595 One narration of Ibn Masood ads the following words. من وافق موته عندانقضاء رمضان دخل الجنة ... شرح الصدور 1/306 دارالمعرفة . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
